title: WaterColor "Whitecaps" 223 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 8 bands to access WaterColor amenities and community pools- Located in the beautiful Park community of WaterColor- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- 5 adult bikes - Private Pool * Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $30 per day.- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*This home will be undergoing a full renovation beginning 3/1/26.Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Located in the beautiful Park community of WaterColor, Whitecaps is a spacious 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom house that sleeps 8. Surrounded by natural green spaces and parks, guests will love the quick walk across the street to the nearest beach access and the private beach club in WaterColor. With over 4,000 square feet of living space, relaxing in the private pool, cozy TV room, and upstairs balcony is easy!Experience spectacular Florida living in this inviting 2-story home adorned with a beautiful, clean beach aesthetic. Sink into the plush slip-covered furniture while enjoying the company of loved ones or catching up on the news. An adjacent TV room provides the perfect setting for a family movie night or a cozy retreat to entertain the kids. Meanwhile, adults can socialize in the reading area, gathered around a small coffee table. The pristine kitchen boasts sleek countertops and high-end appliances, creating a culinary haven. Find comfort and style in the spacious dining area, where a modern light fixture illuminates a table that comfortably seats 6. Step through elegant French doors from nearly every room on the first floor to delight in the covered patio and pool area. Guests can bask in the sun-kissed pool during the day or sip wine with friends at night. When it’s time to retire, there is 1 primary bedroom on this floor with a king bed and private bathroom.The second floor boasts 3 comfy bedrooms and a laundry room for convenience. Friends and family can choose from a guest bedroom with a private bathroom and access to the top-floor balcony, a versatile bedroom with 2 twin beds, or a primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and a peaceful sitting area with access to a private balcony with lounge chairs and neighborhood views.Whitecaps is a spacious retreat in a great location! With on-site parking—plus 5 complimentary adult bikes—it’s easy to explore shops and restaurants in Seaside or Grayton Beach.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo*A Low-Speed Vehicle is not included with the rental of this home. The WaterColor HOA only allows Low-Speed Vehicle rentals through the Electric Cart Company, on a limited, first come first serve basis. You may contact the Electric Cart Company directly.*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.

Whitecaps is a spacious retreat in a great location! With on-site parking—plus 5 complimentary adult bikes—it’s easy to explore shops and restaurants in Seaside or Grayton Beach.
